quote: On March 2, 2026, the Company entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with NVIDIA Corporation ("NVIDIA"), pursuant to which the Company issued and sold 7,788,161 shares of Common Stock at a price of $256.80 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of $2 billion.
